name: YYStoken
rootCause: Root cause is the same as STM token exploit, wrong calculation of liquidity amount to remove in "sell" function. Vulnerable code snippet: https://bscscan.com/address/0xcC0F0f41f4c4c17493517dd6c6d9DD1aDb134Fc9#code Attack tx: https://app.blocksec.com/explorer/tx/bsc/0x397a09af6494c0bfcd89e010f5dd65d90f3ee1cf1ff813ce5b0c1d42a1c8dec9 Analysis: It's similar to STM token, used "sell" function to drain pool. He swapped large amount of USDT to YYS, and in first "sell" function, he could remove some liquidity with a few YYS tokens, decrease k(x*y) value. Then swapped YYS to USDT https://www.notion.so
